subject: Technical demo: Arclight — quickstart intake
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@arclight.io>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Technical demo: Arclight — quickstart intake

Hi Samir —

Thanks for trying out the docs quickstart and for the signal that you have developer intent. I saw your sign-up and wanted to introduce myself and get a 30-minute technical session on the calendar to run through: a) the quickstart you tried, b) how the runtime handles cold-start / KV cache behavior, and c) sizing/latency expectations for a small POC.

Propose three 30-min windows next week (all PST):
- Tue 12/15, 11:00–11:30 AM
- Wed 12/16, 2:00–2:30 PM
- Thu 12/17, 10:00–10:30 AM

Ava (cc'd) will join to cover runtime/quantization recommendations. If none of these work, send a couple of times that do and we will adapt. I attached a short quickstart guide and a one‑page agenda to help prepare.

Quick checklist for the call: code sample ready, expected peak tokens/sec, any compliance constraints.

Thanks — looking forward to connecting.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf (attachment)
- demo-agenda.md (attachment)

From: Samir Gupta <samir@arclight.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Technical demo: Arclight — quickstart intake

Hi Ben —

Thanks for reaching out. We are excited to evaluate Redwood — I ran the quickstart and want to validate throughput and token costs for a prototype.

My availability next week (PST):
- Tue 12/15 after 3 PM
- Thu 12/17 between 9–12 PM

If possible, we prefer Thu 12/17 morning. Also, we'll have one engineer (Priya) join from our side — I'll share her calendar if needed.

A few prep notes: we are testing a 6B open model, likely < 2k sequence lengths, and will want to measure cold-start latency under low traffic.

Regards,
Samir Gupta
Head of AI, Arclight
samir@arclight.io
+1 (617) 555-0987
